subtasks.instruction: Implement `is_valid(order)` in orders/validation.py only. Return False when `order` is not a dict or is missing any required field (order_id, currency, quantity, unit_price_cents). Require order_id to be a str and nonempty after trimming; currency to be one of CNY, EUR, USD; quantity to be an int (excluding bool) in 1..1000 inclusive; unit_price_cents to be an int (excluding bool) in 0..1000000 inclusive. Ignore extra fields, do not mutate the input, and use only the Python standard library. Do not modify tests, ruff.toml, or any other module. Verify with `python -m unittest tests.test_validation` and `python -m ruff check orders/validation.py`.

subtasks.name: totals
subtasks.instruction: Implement `sum_by_currency(orders)` in orders/totals.py only. Assume inputs are already validated orders. Return a dictionary mapping each currency to the integer-cent sum of quantity * unit_price_cents across all orders with that currency. Empty input returns {}. Do not mutate the input orders and use only the Python standard library. Do not modify tests, ruff.toml, or any other module. Verify with `python -m unittest tests.test_totals` and `python -m ruff check orders/totals.py`.

subtasks.name: report
subtasks.instruction: Implement `export_csv(orders)` in orders/report.py only. Assume inputs are already validated orders. Return a CSV string with header row `order_id,currency,subtotal_cents` followed by one row per order in the same input order, where subtotal_cents is quantity * unit_price_cents as an integer. Use the standard library csv module with CRLF line endings and proper quoting (e.g. order IDs containing commas or quotes must round-trip through csv.reader). Always include the header, including for empty input. Do not mutate the input and use only the Python standard library. Do not modify tests, ruff.toml, or any other module. Verify with `python -m unittest tests.test_report` and `python -m ruff check orders/report.py`.
